notes.title: Update V1.02
notes.notes:
Thanks again for all the feedback. We've made more changes to make the game less challenging, worked on the audio and improved the game's performance. We've also added some new missions and extra objects for you to use when making your own missions. 
 
- Improved the visibility of the objects when playing Easy mode
- Improved game rendering "stutter" for (Simple setting) by adjusting the quality of the river 
- Fixed background/ambient audio volume failing to play
- Reviewed mission text and added more clues 
- added 2 extra missions (you'll find them at the end of the list of missions) 
- added 4 extra objects for you to use when creating missions (Crashed Helicopter, Remote control plane, Remote control helicopter, Bungee rope gear)
 
The team is now working on more objects and missions - so keep those ideas coming and thanks again for your support!

notes.title: Update V.101
notes.notes:
First thanks for all the feedback. The main focus of this update is to make the missions easier to complete plus we've added some new missions and extra objects for you to use when making your own missions.
 
- You can now run and cycle for longer
- Reviewed mission text and added more clues
- Reviewed missions and added more time where needed
- Improved the visibility of the search circles on the map
- Reduced "time to drown" in water
 
- Improved the background/ambient audio volume
- Improved game rendering "stutter" for low quality graphic settings (Fast, Fastest) by reducing the quality of the river
- Fixed a barrier by a bridge
- Fixed some textures on some objects (the textures failed to draw correctly)
 
- added 4 extra missions (you'll find them at the end of the list of missions)
- added 8 extra objects for you to use when creating missions (Crashed Jeep, SAR car for decoration (cannot drive), Wheel, Plank of Wood, Cooler box, Board Game, Car vehicle tracks, Dragging tracks)
 
This won't be our last update. Besides improving the quality and performance of the game the team is working on more content - missions and objects - so keep those ideas coming and thanks for your support!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Recovery Search & Rescue Simulation
notes.notes:
Recovery Search & Rescue Simulation is Now Available on Steam and 20% off until January 15th!*

Strap on your boots and hook up your compass - as a new recruit to Rescue Team One, you’ll need to use your expert tracking skills to locate a variety of important objects and missing people who have stumbled into the harsh and perilous dangers of your national park.

Navigate woodland trails, deep ravines and fast-flowing rivers on the trail of a journalist looking for the thrill of adventure, or locate some missing pharmaceuticals to save a hiker’s life. Your skills are paramount for the safety of your visitors.

* Discount end at 12:01 PST.
